name: cypfurniture
description: CYP Furniture - storefront (Next.js + GSAP) and API (Node.js + Prisma)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npx tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json
